programmes.t: William Lee Martin: Standing in the Middle
programmes.d: The Texas comic talks about life, marriage, raising five children and living in a country that's in a constant state of flux.
In this special, Tom Green brings his comedic genius to the standup stage.
Michael Yo brings his personal blend of comedy to his debut stand up special; born and raised in Houston, Michael talks about growing up mixed in a place where he really stood out.
Highlights of comedian Eddie Izzard's one-man show at London's Albery Theatre in March 1994 when Izzard was playing a limited seven-week run of his celebrated stand-up show.

Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

programmes.t: Jesus Trejo: Stay at Home Son
programmes.d: Mexican-American comic Jesus Trejo explores his upbringing as an only child to immigrant parents; he recalls learning many of life's lessons in the most unconventional ways, all the while feeling the need to meet his parents' high expectations.
Comic and writer Katrina Davis attempts to process the world around her through Southern observations, drug-related sports facts and a theory on why dying alone makes perfect sense.

From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.
Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

programmes.t: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
programmes.d: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."
The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.
In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.
Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.

programmes.t: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
programmes.d: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.
The comedian examines man's obsession with hardware at the State Theater in Kalamazoo, Mich.
Steve-O goes from humble beginnings as a circus clown to finding fame on "Jackass," performing stunts and tricks.
Marc Maron discusses everything from pornography to religion.
With decades of stand-up experience under her belt, Susan Rice takes the stage to share quips about car troubles and the joys of getting older.
Comic Nicole Burch performs her hilarious stand-up routine.
Joel McHale discusses feeding alligators in the south and wanting to name the San Francisco 49er's to something else.
Standup comic Helen Hong recounts spending her COVID-19 quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and trying to teach the world that China is not the only country in Asia.
Danny Martinello's debut special dedicated to those who had his back when he decided to put down the bottle.
